exposure: IM atropine (0.01-0.5 mg) and hyoscine (20 mg) combination
outcome: duration of the active phase of labor
duration of the second stage of labor
cohort: The study included 216 primigravid women admitted to Taleghani Hospital of Arak, Iran, randomly allocated to four groups.
finding: The atropine and hyoscine combination significantly reduced the duration of the active phase and increased Bishop scores in primigravid women without serious maternal or neonatal adverse effects.
